content: {"phoneNote":"\"Navodila za pot\" appears three times in the first two screens (header, hero, info band) and the hero photo is washed out under a heavy maroon tint, so the salon barely shows.","desktopNote":"The hero photo is drowned in a maroon overlay and the \"Navodila za pot\" link is repeated in header, hero and info band, while the parking section leaves a large empty right half.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Keep one \"Navodila za pot\" link (in the info band) and drop the duplicates in the header and hero; the phone number stays the single hero action.","Lighten the hero overlay to a soft gradient on the left only so the salon interior reads; alternatively use a split layout with the photo untinted.","Tighten the parking section: on desktop pair the stacked photos with the hours/address or shrink its height; on phone reduce the gap between the photos and the services heading."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: the \"Navodila za pot\" link is repeated in the header, the hero and the info band directly below."]}
